name: Säynätsalo Town Hall
scope: The exterior of Säynätsalo Town Hall, including the red-brick council chamber and low municipal ranges, the original library wing and the raised courtyard with its two approaches.
era: The maintained town hall complex completed in 1952.

originalReview.notes: An original photograph of the built courtyard, with the council chamber, roof offset, dark glazing, red brick, planted court and water edge.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Used only the exact cleared MaSii photograph of the original building. The Qualla photograph of a separate architectural model has been omitted.
